judged_text: Public embed hot path (embed_controller.rb `ensure_embeddable` → embeddable_host.rb `host_allowed?`/`record_for_host`) now runs an uncached DB query (`where("lower(host) = ?", host).first`) on every `/embed/comments` and `/embed/count` request, replacing the previous cached in-memory site-setting allowlist check and adding an uncacheable SQL roundtrip per request on the highest-traffic unauthenticated endpoint; fix by caching the host list in memory/Redis (invalidated on host CRUD) or at minimum loading all rows once per request and comparing in memory.

adjudication.rationale: The diff changes the public embed authorization check from an in-memory SiteSetting allowlist to a database-backed lookup: `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` now calls `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?(request.referer)` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb), which calls `record_for_host` and executes `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first` (app/models/embeddable_host.rb). Nothing in the diff adds caching or memoization, so each unauthenticated `/embed/comments` and `/embed/count` request will perform at least one SQL query to validate the referer host. This is a concrete performance/architecture regression concern on a hot path, but not a functional correctness defect shown by the diff.
